response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with a broad, high-quality background in web, backend, and tooling work, but the fit for this role is poor on nearly every hard requirement. The position requires native-level Japanese, which is not indicated anywhere on the resume (English, Romanian fluent, basic German). It also requires strong C for UNIX development and Linux kernel investigation/modification — his C/C++ exposure is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis project, with the last decade spent almost entirely in TypeScript/Node.js/DLang. There is no evidence of embedded LAN-switch firmware, MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal, L2/L3 switching, SNMP/NETCONF/Telemetry, chip-vendor SDKs, or bootloader/BIOS work. The general engineering strength and testing/craftsmanship discipline are real assets, but they do not offset the missing domain and language prerequisites.
strengths: 15+ years of software development with strong engineering discipline (TDD, CI/CD, tooling)
Polyglot and adaptable — has shipped in C/C++, DLang, Java, Swift, TypeScript across domains
Some low-level/systems exposure: NI LabWindows/CVI C components, Linux/JACK audio thesis, high-performance async services
concerns: No evidence of Japanese language ability, which is a native-level hard requirement
Minimal recent C/UNIX work and no Linux kernel source analysis or modification experience
No embedded networking or security domain experience (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3, switch chips, SNMP/NETCONF)

key_factors.factor: Lacks embedded networking/security and Linux kernel experience
Strong general senior engineering track record
